=== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ===
The lead is a crop of the closest man in the Facebook profile circular, a four-man porch photograph. Exact legal name already on the wiki plus membership in the Star Wars CCG Facebook group (facebook.com/nicolas.beland). Nicolas is the bald man with sunglasses and a goatee in the foreground; chat avatars on the profile use this same circular. Lives Sherbrooke, Quebec; Fleurimont is a Sherbrooke borough. Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook profile screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Nicolas Beland portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Nicolas Beland Facebook portrait.jpg]].
